title: SRMT: Shared Memory for Multi-agent Lifelong Pathfinding
abstract: arXiv:2501.13200v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Coordination in decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) necessitates that agents share information about their behavior and intentions. Existing approaches rely on communication protocols with domain or resource constraints or centralized training that poorly scales to large agent populations. We introduce the Shared Recurrent Memory Transformer (SRMT), which enables coordination through unconstrained communication. SRMT provides a global memory workspace where agents broadcast their learned working memory states and query others' memory representations to exchange information and coordinate while maintaining decentralized training and execution. We evaluate SRMT on the Partially Observable Multi-Agent Pathfinding (PO-MAPF) problem, where coordination is vital for optimal path planning and deadlock avoidance. translated_title: SRMT：多智能体终身路径规划中的共享记忆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.13200v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：在分散式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，协调要求智能体共享其行为和意图的信息。现有方法依赖于具有领域或资源约束的通信协议，或依赖于难以扩展到大规模智能体群体的集中式训练。我们引入了共享循环记忆变换器（SRMT），它通过无约束通信实现协调。SRMT提供了一个全局记忆工作空间，智能体在其中广播其学到的循环记忆状态，并查询其他智能体的记忆表示以交换信息和协调，同时保持分散式训练和执行。我们在部分可观测多智能体路径规划（PO-MAPF）问题上评估了SRMT，在该问题中，协调对于最优路径规划和死锁避免至关重要。我们证明，即使奖励函数提供最小信号，共享记忆也能实现涌现协调。
tldr: 本文提出SRMT，通过全局共享记忆工作空间实现无约束通信，在保持分散式训练和执行的同时，解决了多智能体路径规划中的协调问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SRMT, which enables coordination via a global shared memory workspace with unconstrained communication, addressing multi-agent pathfinding while maintaining decentralized training and execution.
